prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Seeking senior Full-Stack developer who is an expert with DALL-E 2 to build text to image Saas
We are building a Saas product (and desktop application via Electron) that will connect to the DALL-E 2 API, as well as the ChatGPT API to generate images and text. We are looking for an extremely skilled, full-stack, developer that has worked with AI and loves that field. The full-stack developer will be solo coding this application, and so needs to be someone that is self-driven and knows how to stay on task and GET STUFF DONE. By the end of this coming week, we will have the UI designed for the product, which will be inside of our Figma account. It will be your role to take our design and program it to function really well. This is not a project for a junior developer. This is a LONG-TERM senior level developer role. After we release the product, you will be hired full-time and it will be on-going, so this is not a short-term job position. This is a VERY stable, long-term position for 1 talented programmer to join a proven company who has been in business for over 20 years. Please respond with why you feel you are a good fit for this specific role. Speak directly to this post and PLEASE do not respond with a generic, copy/paste reply or you will be ignored. We are a serious employer who takes very good care of our team members, so we expect a serious developer in return.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text: You need a senior full-stack developer who can turn a Figma design into a reliable SaaS and Electron app that connects to the DALL-E 2 and ChatGPT APIs, and I’d be glad to help build that end to end. With 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack development, HTML, and CSS, I’m comfortable owning both the frontend and backend work needed for a product like this. I work well independently, stay focused on execution, and can move quickly while keeping the UI polished and the architecture solid for long-term growth. I’d also be careful about making the app maintainable so it can support ongoing development after launch. What are the first core workflows you want built once the Figma designs are ready?
